'''Otoh Langua''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] some 3000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].

==History==
Otoh Langua was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="SW:GB" /> in [[3000 BBY]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[War of the Gungan tribes]].<ref name="EA" /> During the War, when [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]] tried to unite the Gungan villages and defeat Boss [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]], Otoh Langua was led by Boss [[Hantic]], and the city included a [[Command center]]. The city of [[Otoh Jahai]] battled Otoh Lungua because Boss [[Tenko]] claimed Langua had taken their [[Sacred Staff]]. Langua also fought Jahai because their city's funds were stolen by Rogoe and fighting was the only means of profit. Boss Gallo and Captain [[Marsune (Gungan)|Marsune]] found the staff in a [[Forest/Legends|forest]] and returned it to Jahai, ending the fighting. They also had a skirmish against several of Rogoe's soldiers at a small base of his and liberated the [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] Rogoe's thieves stole, ending Langua's economic troubles. Langua gave Gallo and Marsune military support after their troubles were fixed.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Otoh Langua appears in the Gungan campaign in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] expansion pack [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']].
